subject: math
question:
设 $A$ 是 $n$ 阶实对称矩阵，且 $\operatorname{rank}(A) = r$ 。证明：

(1) A 有 r 阶主子式（行号与列号相同的子式）不为零；

(2) A 的 r 阶不为零的主子式的符号均相同.

steps.text:
分析 （1）设 A 不为 0 的 r 阶子式的行号为 $i_{1}, i_{2}, \cdots, i_{r}$ ，列号为 $j_{1}, j_{2}, \cdots, j_{r}$ 。则这 r 个列向量是矩阵 A 列向量组的极大无关组。由 A 的对称性，列号为 $i_{1}, i_{2}, \cdots, i_{r}$ 的向量组也是 A 列向量组的极大无关组，从而这两个向量组等价。由此就很容易得到这个 r 阶子式与对应主子式的关系。

（2）与（1）的推理相同，两个非零主子式的列向量组等价，从而两个主子式的关系也就确定了.

（1）记 A 中由 $i_{1}, i_{2}, \cdots, i_{r}$ 行与 $j_{1}, j_{2}, \cdots, j_{r}$ 列交叉点元素组成的 r 阶子式为 $A\left(\begin{array}{c}i_{1}, i_{2}, \cdots, i_{r}\\ j_{1}, j_{2}, \cdots, j_{r}\end{array}\right)$ .
由于 $\operatorname{rank}(A)=r$ ，则存在 A 的一个 r 阶子式 $A\left(\begin{array}{c}i_{1},i_{2},\cdots,i_{r}\\ j_{1},j_{2},\cdots,j_{r}\end{array}\right)\neq0$ .

由 A 对称知，又有 $A\left(\begin{array}{l}j_{1},j_{2},\cdots,j_{r}\\i_{1},i_{2},\cdots,i_{r}\end{array}\right)\neq0$ 。记 A 的第 i 个列向量为 $\alpha_{i}(i=1,2,\cdots,n)$ ，则 $\alpha_{j_{1}},\alpha_{j_{2}},\cdots,\alpha_{j_{r}}$ 与 $\alpha_{i_{1}},\alpha_{i_{2}},\cdots,\alpha_{i_{r}}$ 都是 A 的列向量组的极大无关组，从而是等价的，即存在 r 阶可逆矩阵 C 使得

$$
\left(\alpha_ {j _ {1}}, \alpha_ {j _ {2}}, \dots , \alpha_ {j _ {r}}\right) = \left(\alpha_ {i _ {1}}, \alpha_ {i _ {2}}, \dots , \alpha_ {i _ {r}}\right) C.
$$

等式左端矩阵的任意 $r$ 阶子式都是 $\pmb{A}$ 的 $r$ 阶子式，因此有

$$
\boldsymbol {A} \binom {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} = \boldsymbol {A} \binom {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} {i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}} | \boldsymbol {C} | \neq 0,
$$

即 A 有 r 阶主子式不为零.

(2) 设 $A\left(\begin{array}{l}i_{1},i_{2},\cdots,i_{r}\\ i_{1},i_{2},\cdots,i_{r}\end{array}\right)\neq0$ ， $A\left(\begin{array}{l}j_{1},j_{2},\cdots,j_{r}\\ j_{1},j_{2},\cdots,j_{r}\end{array}\right)\neq0$ 是 A 的两个非零 r 阶主子式。据（1）中讨论知，存在 r 阶可逆矩阵 C 使得

$$
\left(\alpha_ {j _ {1}}, \alpha_ {j _ {2}}, \dots , \alpha_ {j _ {r}}\right) = \left(\alpha_ {i _ {1}}, \alpha_ {i _ {2}}, \dots , \alpha_ {i _ {r}}\right) C.
$$

等式左端矩阵的任意 $r$ 阶子式都是 $\pmb{A}$ 的 $r$ 阶子式，因此有

$$
\boldsymbol {A} \binom {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} = \boldsymbol {A} \binom {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} {i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}} | \boldsymbol {C} |,

\boldsymbol {A} \binom{i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}}{j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} = \boldsymbol {A} \binom{i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}}{i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}} | \boldsymbol {C} |.
$$

由 $\pmb{A}$ 对称知

$$
A \binom {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} {i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}} = A \binom {i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}} {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}},
$$

所以

$$
\boldsymbol {A} \binom {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} = \boldsymbol {A} \binom {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} {i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}} | \boldsymbol {C} | = \boldsymbol {A} \binom {i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}} {j _ {1}, j _ {2}, \dots , j _ {r}} | \boldsymbol {C} | = \boldsymbol {A} \binom {i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}} {i _ {1}, i _ {2}, \dots , i _ {r}} | \boldsymbol {C} | ^ {2}.
$$

由于 $|C|^{2}>0$ ，所以 $A\left(\begin{array}{l}i_{1},i_{2},\cdots,i_{r}\\ i_{1},i_{2},\cdots,i_{r}\end{array}\right)$ 与 $A\left(\begin{array}{l}j_{1},j_{2},\cdots,j_{r}\\ j_{1},j_{2},\cdots,j_{r}\end{array}\right)$ 同号.
